description.value: Stephens Coyote Ridge Regional Park is a regional nature reserve near Kelowna managed by the Regional District of Central Okanagan. It is part of a network of 30 regional parks encompassing over 2,100 hectares, with designated trails winding through Central Okanagan landscapes. The park is day-use only, offering a natural rest stop or side trip for touring cyclists exploring the Kelowna area.
